purpose: Normalized discovery inventory for P4. Inventory does not grant execution authority.

audited_subcapabilities.name: skill-format-specification
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The specification defines portable structure and metadata but is not itself an execution capability. Client behavior, especially experimental allowed-tools handling, remains implementation-specific.

audited_subcapabilities.name: skills-ref-reference-library
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The upstream README explicitly states that skills-ref is for demonstration and is not meant for production use.

audited_subcapabilities.name: executable-script-convention
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The format permits bundled executable code and the authoring guidance recommends package runners that may fetch and execute dependencies; each concrete skill still needs its own authority and provenance review.

audited_subcapabilities.name: allowed-tools-field
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The allowed-tools field is explicitly experimental and its support varies across agent implementations, so Agent OS must not treat it as a portable authority grant.

audited_subcapabilities.name: curated-marketplace
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The marketplace mixes local OpenAI-curated bundles with external repository sources and multiple authentication policies; repository curation is not sufficient for blanket runtime admission.

audited_subcapabilities.name: remote-mcp-plugins
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Numerous plugins bind to remote MCP endpoints with authenticated access to SaaS or developer accounts and may expose write-capable tools.

audited_subcapabilities.name: local-mcp-and-script-plugins
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Several plugins launch local Node or script-backed MCP servers and may access credentials, files, networks or generated artifacts.

audited_subcapabilities.name: github-plugin
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The GitHub plugin is explicitly interactive/write capable and supports PR, issue, CI and publishing workflows.

audited_subcapabilities.name: communication-and-productivity-plugins
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Email, chat, calendar, drive and productivity plugins can access personal or organizational data and perform remote writes.

audited_subcapabilities.name: developer-and-infrastructure-plugins
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Developer-platform bundles include deployment, infrastructure, observability, security and source-control workflows whose authority must remain task-scoped.

audited_subcapabilities.name: finance-commerce-and-investing-plugins
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Finance, investing, payments and commerce surfaces require independent domain and authority controls rather than marketplace-wide trust.

audited_subcapabilities.name: openai-first-party-plugins
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: First-party provenance does not remove execution risk; reviewed OpenAI plugins can create API keys, write repositories, run local MCP services or instrument applications.

audited_subcapabilities.name: plugin-creator
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The creator skill writes plugin trees and marketplace metadata and can add MCP, hooks and scripts, so it requires explicit file-scope authority.

audited_subcapabilities.name: external-marketplace-references
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Marketplace entries that install from external repositories require their own provenance and capability audits; OpenAI marketplace inclusion does not substitute for upstream review.

audited_subcapabilities.name: attach-db
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Useful database attachment workflow, but it writes shared state and can create a database after user confirmation.

audited_subcapabilities.name: convert-file
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Conversion writes user-selected outputs and can access remote sources or install/load extensions.

audited_subcapabilities.name: duckdb-docs
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Documentation lookup is narrow in purpose but installs extensions, downloads indexes, and writes a local cache.

audited_subcapabilities.name: install-duckdb
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Installer/updater authority is materially broader than a reference skill and includes community-extension and CLI-upgrade paths.

audited_subcapabilities.name: query
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Ad-hoc mode contains useful path/external-access restrictions, but session mode restores shared state that may include secrets and attached databases.

audited_subcapabilities.name: read-file
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Broad file readers and remote credential-chain support exceed a default reference-only trust boundary.

audited_subcapabilities.name: read-memories
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Reads historical Claude Code session logs and therefore crosses a private-context boundary unsuitable for generic automatic admission.

audited_subcapabilities.name: s3-explore
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Remote object-store exploration requires network and may use credentials or explicit access secrets.

audited_subcapabilities.name: spatial
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Can query remote public datasets, install community extensions, and export local spatial files.

audited_subcapabilities.name: cloudflare
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Primarily architecture and product selection guidance, but routes into deployment, secrets, shell, MCP and account-management surfaces.

audited_subcapabilities.name: agents-sdk
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Useful SDK guidance but includes MCP and deployment-oriented workflows.

audited_subcapabilities.name: cloudflare-email-service
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Can enable email services, use API tokens and send external email.

audited_subcapabilities.name: cloudflare-one-migrations
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Migration planning is useful, but the skill covers high-impact security and network configuration changes.

audited_subcapabilities.name: cloudflare-one
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Can inspect and configure identity, access, Gateway, network and security policies; broad production authority is explicitly discussed.

audited_subcapabilities.name: durable-objects
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Mostly implementation guidance but includes stateful production patterns and Wrangler configuration.

audited_subcapabilities.name: nextjs-on-cloudflare
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Explicitly instructs installing upstream skills and supports project migration/deployment.

audited_subcapabilities.name: sandbox-migrate-to-next
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Migration path includes shell/runtime changes, deployment and potentially destructive edits.

audited_subcapabilities.name: sandbox-next
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Sandbox applications expose shell/runtime execution and deployment surfaces.

audited_subcapabilities.name: sandbox-stable
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Stable sandbox guidance still covers execution, deployment and secret/configuration changes.

audited_subcapabilities.name: turnstile-spin
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Contains executable shell scripts, token/secret handling and remote widget creation/configuration.

audited_subcapabilities.name: web-perf
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Audit guidance is comparatively narrow, but it can install/configure Chrome DevTools MCP and operates browser/network tooling.

audited_subcapabilities.name: workers-best-practices
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Mostly guidance, but directly affects production Worker code/configuration and secret-related practices.

audited_subcapabilities.name: wrangler
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Wrangler is a broad resource-management and deployment surface with account credentials and remote mutations.

audited_subcapabilities.name: skill-installation
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The documented install command copies skills into workspace or home-directory agent skill locations.

audited_subcapabilities.name: browser-navigation-and-interaction
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Core browser actions can change external application state and upload local files.

audited_subcapabilities.name: browser-observation
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Snapshots, screenshots, requests and console inspection are useful but still expose page data and can write local artifacts.

audited_subcapabilities.name: storage-state
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The skill can inspect, mutate, persist, restore and delete cookies and browser storage, including authenticated state.

audited_subcapabilities.name: run-code
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: run-code evaluates arbitrary Playwright functions with browser-context access, permissions and file-download capabilities.

audited_subcapabilities.name: webmcp
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Page-registered WebMCP tools are explicitly untrusted and may have remote side effects when called.

audited_subcapabilities.name: persistent-and-attached-sessions
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Attaching to existing browsers or persistent profiles can expose authenticated sessions and unrelated browsing state.

audited_subcapabilities.name: request-mocking
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Route/unroute commands alter browser network behavior and can materially change application behavior under test.

audited_subcapabilities.name: test-generation-and-healing
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: Generation and healing workflows can write or modify test code based on browser interactions.

audited_subcapabilities.name: evidence-capture-and-pr-attachments
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The skill can generate visual artifacts and instruct attaching them to GitHub pull requests, crossing a publication boundary.

audited_subcapabilities.name: npm-installation
audited_subcapabilities.rationale: The skill instructs global installation of the latest CLI when unavailable locally.
